record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: Let V be an n-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over E/F and let π be an irreducible admissible representation of GL(V) with A-parameter M_A = ⊕_i M_i ⊠ Sym^{d_i}(C^2), where each M_i is tempered. Prove the nontempered twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture that if Hom_{U(V)}(π, ω_{V,ψ,μ}) is nonzero, then M_A must be a sum of a tempered A-parameter together with pieces of the form N_i ⊠ Sym^{d_i}(C^2) ⊕ μ·N_i^σ ⊠ Sym^{d_i-1}(C^2), equivalently that M_A and μ·M_A^σ are relevant in the sense of GGP3; and conversely, if those parameters are relevant, then Hom_{U(V)}(π, ω_{V,ψ,μ}) is one-dimensional for exactly one skew-Hermitian space V, namely the one predicted by Conjecture 2.1(iii).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E/F$ be a quadratic extension of local fields with nontrivial Galois automorphism $\sigma$, let $\psi$ be a nontrivial additive character of $F$, and let $\mu$ be a conjugate-symplectic character of $E^\times$. Let $V$ be an $n$-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over $E$, and let $U(V)$ denote its unitary group, embedded diagonally in $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ (viewed as an algebraic group over $F$ via Weil restriction). Let $\omega_{V,\psi,\mu}$ be the associated Weil representation of $U(V)\times U(V)$ (or its restriction to $U(V)$ via the splitting determined by $\mu$).

Let $\pi$ be an irreducible admissible representation of $\mathrm{GL}(V)$ whose Arthur parameter has the form
$$M_A = \bigoplus_i M_i \boxtimes \mathrm{Sym}^{d_i}(\mathbb{C}^2),$$
where each $M_i$ is a tempered representation of the appropriate Weil–Deligne group and $\mathrm{Sym}^{d_i}(\mathbb{C}^2)$ denotes the $(d_i+1)$-dimensional irreducible representation of $\mathrm{SL}_2(\mathbb{C})$. Write $M_A^\sigma$ for the $\sigma$-conjugate parameter, and call a pair $(M_A,\mu\cdot M_A^\sigma)$ "relevant" if it satisfies the combinatorial relevance condition formulated for the twisted GGP setting (i.e., the parameter decomposes as a tempered piece plus summands of the form $N_i\boxtimes \mathrm{Sym}^{d_i}(\mathbb{C}^2)\oplus \mu\cdot N_i^\sigma\boxtimes \mathrm{Sym}^{d_i-1}(\mathbb{C}^2)$, with each $N_i$ tempered).

Prove the following two statements:

(a) If $\mathrm{Hom}_{U(V)}(\pi,\omega_{V,\psi,\mu})\neq 0$, then $M_A$ decomposes as a direct sum of a tempered $A$-parameter together with summands of the form
$$N_i\boxtimes \mathrm{Sym}^{d_i}(\mathbb{C}^2)\;\oplus\;\mu\cdot N_i^\sigma\boxtimes \mathrm{Sym}^{d_i-1}(\mathbb{C}^2),$$
equivalently, $M_A$ and $\mu\cdot M_A^\sigma$ are relevant.

(b) Conversely, if $M_A$ and $\mu\cdot M_A^\sigma$ are relevant, then there exists exactly one skew-Hermitian space $V$ in the relevant Witt tower (the one singled out by the epsilon-dichotomy prediction in the associated tempered GGP conjecture) for which $\mathrm{Hom}_{U(V)}(\pi,\omega_{V,\psi,\mu})$ is one-dimensional, and for all other skew-Hermitian spaces this Hom space vanishes.
artifact.status_search_result: The nontempered twisted GGP conjecture for unitary groups in the skew-Hermitian setting appears to remain open in general. Progress has been made on the tempered twisted GGP conjecture (e.g., for certain tempered L-packets via theta correspondence, and globally under unramifiedness assumptions), and on the Fourier–Jacobi (skew-Hermitian) tempered case by Liu–Xue, but no general proof of the nontempered twisted conjecture as formulated has been published.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for certain tempered L-packets
status_evidence.snippet: Twisted GGP established for certain tempered L-packets via theta correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Only the tempered twisted GGP has been verified in this family of cases, not the nontempered version.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad conjecture for unramified quadratic extensions
status_evidence.snippet: Proves twisted global GGP for U(V) in GL(V) under unramifiedness assumptions.
status_evidence.claim: Tempered/global twisted version partially established; nontempered case not proved.

status_evidence.title: The local twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for U(V_K)/U(V)
status_evidence.snippet: Recent work on local twisted GGP.
status_evidence.claim: Ongoing work on twisted GGP; nontempered conjecture not settled.
